Resolves #20538

Related: #20496, #20498, #20519, #20539, #20542, #20543, #20544, neomjs/neo-agent-skills#307, neomjs/neo-agent-skills#308

Removes front-door niche gatekeeping, adoption-discouraging caveats, and the outdated 2025 5-MCP-server list from root `README.md` and documents the `guide-authoring` anti-underselling & `src/` capability-breadth bar in `learn/agentos/CoreSkills.md` (paired with companion PR [`neomjs/neo-agent-skills#308`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/pull/308) / [`#307`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/issues/307)):
1. **Root `README.md` (`### 🤖 The Body`, `## Who This Is For`, `## Architecture` → `### The Brain (Agent OS)`):** Positions Neo.mjs as a complete `461`-class platform across `39` namespaces for **every desktop and mobile web application** ([`100,000`-row](./examples/grid/bigData) [grids](./learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md), `26` form field types with nested forms, calendars, `42`-class multi-window Dock Layouts, `8` layouts, `38` main-thread addons; linking [Angular, React, or Vue](./learn/comparisons/Overview.md) and [Ext JS](./learn/comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md)) that also scales to `40,000+` delta updates/sec and multi-window `SharedWorker` workspaces; explains that because LLMs excel at JSON and Neo.mjs has been [JSON-first since its November 2019 GA](./learn/benefits/body/JSONFirstUIs.md), coding agents read and write Neo.mjs blueprints natively; removes the adoption-discouraging `**Not designed for**` paragraph; and replaces the 5-MCP-server / `File System MCP server` list under `### The Brain (Agent OS)` with the two-hemisphere Agent OS architecture (`Neural Link` as the bridge into the Body's Possession Interface, `Memory Core & Native Edge Graph`, `DreamService & Golden Path`, `Semantic Knowledge Base`, `A2A Coordination & GitHub Workflow`, and `Fleet Manager` starting the agents' harnesses and showing their roster, health, work, memories, messages, and wake state).
2. **`learn/agentos/CoreSkills.md` (`guide-authoring`):** Records the anti-underselling, `src/` capability-breadth (`42`-class multi-window Dock Layouts), JSON-first LLM fluency, and no-legacy-flattery bar in the tracked Engine guide, paired with companion PR [`neomjs/neo-agent-skills#308`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/pull/308) (`0.1.96`).

Evidence: L1 (static contract: `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` across all 174 `learn/` + root entry docs and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs`) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).
